name: execute_python
title: Execute Python
description: Execute Python code inside the running FreeCAD GUI process. 'App'/'FreeCAD' and 'Gui'/'FreeCADGui' are pre-bound. Do not import them. Captured stdout/stderr is returned. Unless the bridge's permission mode is Unrestricted, FreeCAD shows the user the code first, and the call waits up to the response timeout for their answer. If the answer has not come by then, the call returns a job_token, and get_output_page returns the output once they answer, or the decline as an error. Each call is one step in FreeCAD's Edit → Undo, named "MCP Bridge: run"; code that opens its own transactions makes it a chain of named steps, so leave transactions alone.

code.description: Python source to execute in the FreeCAD session.

name: execute_python_file
title: Execute Python file
description: Read a local Python file and execute it inside the running FreeCAD GUI process. Same execution context as execute_python. Unless the bridge's permission mode is Unrestricted, FreeCAD shows the user the file first, and the call waits up to the response timeout for their answer. If the answer has not come by then, the call returns a job_token, and get_output_page returns the output once they answer, or the decline as an error. Each call is one step in FreeCAD's Edit → Undo, named "MCP Bridge: run"; code that opens its own transactions makes it a chain of named steps, so leave transactions alone.

name: get_output_page
title: Get output page
description: Retrieve a page of output for a prior execute call that returned has_more=true. To read forward, pass page_no one higher than the last page_no you received (0 if you received none yet); repeat until has_more=false. Requesting a page_no already received replays it.

job_token.description: Token from a previous execute or get_output_page response.

page_no.description: 0-based index of the page to retrieve.
